preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 50000, inclusive.
The number of queries is between 1 and 150000, inclusive.
The integer ai on each vertex is between 0 and n, inclusive.
Each query vertex u and v is between 1 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The given graph is a tree.
preconditions.description: The input graph is guaranteed to be a tree.
For each query, vertex u is an ancestor of vertex v.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly q lines, each corresponding to a query.

postconditions.expression: The output contains the maximal value <image> among all vertices i on path from u to v including u and v.
postconditions.description: For each query, the output must be the maximal value of the bitwise XOR of ai among all vertices i on the path from u to v, including u and v.
